bibl.title: A new Graeco-Egyptian magical amulet of Anguipes with an apotropaic inscription.
bibl.seg: Diego Chapinal-Heras & Sergio España-Chamorro, A new Graeco-Egyptian magical amulet of Anguipes with an apotropaic inscription.
bibl.note: Sotheby's New York Lot, Auction: Ancient Marbles: Classical Sculpture and Works of Art, 13 June 2016, Lot 92. Provenance unknown, 3rd-4th century CE. Contains a protection formula and the depiction of several deities, including Anguipes and Harpocrates. - 1. Presentation of the amulet. - 2. Commentary. - 3. Iconography. - 4. Some conclusions.
